identity.name: Sodium benzoate
identity.chemical_class: Sodium salt of benzoic acid (aromatic carboxylate preservative)

function.mechanism: Weak-acid preservative system (benzoic acid/benzoate) that suppresses microbial growth, especially in acidic foods and beverages.

adi.basis: Group ADI for benzoic acid and benzoates (E210-E213), expressed as benzoic acid

efsa.key_finding: EFSA's 2016 re-evaluation maintained authorization but reported ADI exceedance at high-percentile exposure in some younger groups and wider exceedance when additional benzoic-acid sources were included.

adi.basis: 2021 JECFA group ADI 0-20 mg/kg bw (as benzoic acid equivalents) replacing the previous 0-5 mg/kg bw

concerns.summary: Recent rodent studies reported reproductive-axis disruption, altered sex hormones, and gonadal histopathology after sodium benzoate exposure, with stronger effects at higher or prolonged dosing.
A 2025 systematic review of mammalian-cell studies reported frequent sodium-benzoate-associated cytotoxic/genotoxic signals, though study heterogeneity limits direct human risk quantification.
Mechanistic mouse/cell work reported pancreatic inflammation and beta-cell apoptosis linked with benzoylation pathways under experimental sodium benzoate exposure.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA and JECFA continue ADI-based authorization for sodium benzoate/benzoates rather than prohibition.
No IARC listing/classification found for sodium benzoate in the current classified-agent list data.

adi_exceedance.notes: EFSA 2016 reported high-percentile exceedance in younger groups under refined scenarios; a 2024 regional study also found P95 exceedance scenarios despite means below ADI.

risk_assessment.rationale: Sodium benzoate remains approved/GRAS with explicit ADI and use limits, but EFSA-identified high-consumer exceedance risk and accumulating preclinical mechanistic/reproductive findings justify a moderate rather than limited tier.
key_factors: EFSA approval with group ADI 5 mg/kg bw/day and caveated exposure findings
FDA GRAS framework with conditions of use in 21 CFR 184.1733
JECFA 2021 group ADI update to 0-20 mg/kg bw
No IARC classification for sodium benzoate
Recent preclinical evidence for endocrine/reproductive, inflammatory, and cytogenotoxic concerns
Exposure exceedance risk concentrated in younger/high-intake populations
